text: Assignment two. SCP-096. One rule... never look at its face.
It sits in a steel cube. Curled up. Almost two and a half meters tall. Arms too long.
It's harmless... until someone sees its face. In person. On a camera. Even in a photo.
My job is the observation room. Monitors off. Cameras covered.
Then one of the monitors... flickers on.
Just for a second... I see it. A face.
And somewhere below me... something starts screaming.
It's crying. It's shaking. And it knows exactly where I am.
The alarms start. The doors lock. I run.
Behind me... the steel tears like paper.
Nothing has ever stopped it. Not walls. Not doors. Not distance.
It's not screaming anymore. Which means... it's right behind me.
